title: Branch ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule() on canScheduleExact
name: schedule
description: When exact alarms aren't permitted, fall back to a best-effort WorkManager one-time work item instead of silently doing nothing. Unique work name keyed to the dose id with ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE mirrors the existing cancel-then-reschedule semantics this function already has for the exact-alarm path.
acceptance_criteria: If canScheduleExact(context) is true, behavior is unchanged: alarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(...) as before

If false, computes delayMillis = (triggerAtMillis - System.currentTimeMillis()).coerceAtLeast(0), builds a OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<CoarseReminderWorker>() with setInitialDelay(delayMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) and setInputData(workDataOf(EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID to doseLogId, EXTRA_TITLE to title, EXTRA_TEXT to text))
Enqueues that request via WorkManager.getInstance(context).enqueueUniqueWork("dose_reminder_$doseLogId", ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE, request)
